name: sound
title: Sound
description: The cue every control answers a press with, built on Web Kits Audio.
docs:
Sound: wrap your app once in <SoundEffects> from components/ui/sound.tsx.
Press cues are read from the data-slot attributes on every Kobra component, so keep them.
Browsers hold audio until the page has been clicked, so the first press is silent by design.

.sound-wave.transition: opacity 130ms var(--ease-out) var(--wave-delay), transform 130ms var(--ease-out) var(--wave-delay), filter 130ms var(--ease-out) var(--wave-delay)
